target.title: fix(hooks): bound hook workspace manifest and HOOK.md reads
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`readRootFileUtf8` in `src/hooks/workspace.ts` reads hook `package.json` and `HOOK.md` files with an unbounded `fs.readFileSync` call. A malicious or runaway file in a hook directory could force workspace discovery to buffer an arbitrarily large file into memory, leading to OOM.

## Why This Change Was Made

Both `package.json` and `HOOK.md` are small metadata files. A 1 MiB cap each is generous headroom for legitimate hook documentation and manifests while preventing workspace discovery from being used as a memory exhaustion vector.

## User Impact

Workspace hook discovery now silently skips hook packages with oversized manifests or `HOOK.md` files instead of buffering them into memory.

## Evidence

- Added regression tests for oversized `package.json` and oversized `HOOK.md` in a hook directory, asserting the hooks are skipped.
- Local focused run: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/hooks/workspace.test.ts --run` passes (9/9 tests).


## Real behavior proof

I ran a standalone Node script that imports the real `loadHookEntriesFromDir` from `src/hooks/workspace.ts` and exercises workspace discovery against a temp directory containing:

1. `hooks/normal-hook/HOOK.md` + `handler.js` — small, valid metadata.
2. `hooks/big-pkg/package.json` — 1 MiB + 1 byte (oversized manifest).
3. `hooks/big-md/HOOK.md` — 1 MiB + 1 byte (oversized hook doc) plus `handler.js`.

The script shows that only the normal hook is discovered; both oversized files are rejected before any downstream parsing or handler loading:

```text
$ node --import tsx /tmp/proof-101472.mjs
Workspace hooks dir: /tmp/openclaw-proof-101472-2eKrpS/hooks

Discovered hook entries: 1
  - normal-hook (source=openclaw-workspace)

PASS: only the normal hook was loaded; oversized files were skipped.
```

This confirms the bounded reader rejects oversized `package.json` and `HOOK.md` files during real workspace discovery, so no hook entries are loaded for them and no OOM path is exercised.
